parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start time for the balance history query (ISO 8601 format). Defaults to 7 days ago.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End time for the balance history query (ISO 8601 format). Defaults to now.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Data granularity. 'hourly' returns hourly data points, 'daily' returns daily aggregated data. Defaults to 'hourly'.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: The user ID of the user making the request

parameters.name: Encoded-Data-Message
parameters.description: The data that was signed by the user for signature recovery

parameters.name: Encoded-Data-Signature
parameters.description: The signature of data, used for signature recovery
